Potential XSS vulnerability in jQuery

Aliases: BIT-drupal-2020-11022, CVE-2020-11022

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:L/A:N

Affected:

  • jquery — fixed in 3.5.0

  • maximebf/debugbar — fixed in 1.19.0

### Impact Passing HTML from untrusted sources - even after sanitizing it - to one of jQuery's DOM manipulation methods (i.e. `.html()`, `.append()`, and others) may execute untrusted code. ### Patches This problem is patched in jQuery 3.5.0. ### Workarounds To workaround the issue without upgrading, adding the following to your code: ```js jQuery.htmlPrefilter = function( html ) { return html; }; ``` You need to use at least jQuery 1.12/2.2 or newer to be able to apply this workaround. ### References https://blog.jquery.com/2020/04/10/jquery-3-5-0-released/ https://jquery.com/upgrade-guide/3.5/ ### For more information If you have any questions or comments about this advisory, search for a relevant issue in [the jQuery repo](https://github.com/jquery/jquery/issues). entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-w54j-7wpm-crhj: ImageMagick has a heap-buffer-overflow in FTXT encoder
entry.content:
ImageMagick has a heap-buffer-overflow in FTXT encoder

Aliases: CVE-2026-56374

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L

Affected:

  • Magick.NET-Q16-AnyCPU — fixed in 14.12.0
  • Magick.NET-Q16-HDRI-AnyCPU — fixed in 14.12.0
  • Magick.NET-Q16-HDRI-OpenMP-arm64 — fixed in 14.12.0
  • Magick.NET-Q16-HDRI-arm64 — fixed in 14.12.0
  • Magick.NET-Q16-HDRI-x64 — fixed in 14.12.0
  • Magick.NET-Q16-HDRI-x86 — fixed in 14.12.0
  • Magick.NET-Q16-OpenMP-arm64 — fixed in 14.12.0
  • Magick.NET-Q16-OpenMP-x64 — fixed in 14.12.0
  • Magick.NET-Q16-arm64 — fixed in 14.12.0
  • Magick.NET-Q16-x64 — fixed in 14.12.0
  • Magick.NET-Q16-x86 — fixed in 14.12.0
  • Magick.NET-Q16-HDRI-OpenMP-x64 — fixed in 14.12.0

The FTXT encoder lacks a boundary check when parsing `ftxt:format`, resulting in an out of bounds read. ``` ==3040863==ERROR: AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow on address 0x5020000085b2 at pc 0x606c1ee0c6ce bp 0x7ffee30d6150 sp 0x7ffee30d6148 READ of size 1 at 0x5020000085b2 thread T0 ```

References:

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-w54j-7wpm-crhj
  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick

entry.content:
ImageMagick: Heap-based Buffer Overflow in GetPixelIndex due to metadata-cache desynchronization

Affected:

  • Magick.NET-Q16-AnyCPU — fixed in 14.10.3
  • Magick.NET-Q16-HDRI-AnyCPU — fixed in 14.10.3
  • Magick.NET-Q16-HDRI-OpenMP-arm64 — fixed in 14.10.3
  • Magick.NET-Q16-HDRI-OpenMP-x64 — fixed in 14.10.3

entry.content:
ImageMagick: Memory leak in coders/txt.c without freetype

Aliases: CVE-2026-56371

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:N

Affected:

  • Magick.NET-Q16-AnyCPU — fixed in 14.10.3
  • Magick.NET-Q16-HDRI-AnyCPU — fixed in 14.10.3
  • Magick.NET-Q16-HDRI-OpenMP-arm64 — fixed in 14.10.3
  • Magick.NET-Q16-HDRI-OpenMP-x64 — fixed in 14.10.3
  • Magick.NET-Q16-HDRI-arm64 — fixed in 14.10.3
  • Magick.NET-Q16-HDRI-x64 — fixed in 14.10.3
  • Magick.NET-Q16-HDRI-x86 — fixed in 14.10.3
  • Magick.NET-Q16-OpenMP-arm64 — fixed in 14.10.3
  • Magick.NET-Q16-OpenMP-x64 — fixed in 14.10.3
  • Magick.NET-Q16-OpenMP-x86 — fixed in 14.10.3
  • Magick.NET-Q16-arm64 — fixed in 14.10.3
  • Magick.NET-Q16-x64 — fixed in 14.10.3

If a `texture` attribute is specified for a TXT file, an attempt will be made to read it via `texture=ReadImage(read_info,exception);`. Later, when retrieving metrics via the `GetTypeMetrics` function, if this function fails (i.e., `status == MagickFalse`), the calling function will exit immediately but fail to release the texture object, leading to memory leakage.

References:

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-3q5f-gmjc-38r8
